body: A library for adapting pretrained models by training only a small subset of their parameters.
plain_description: **Adapt large pretrained models to your business tasks with less compute and storage.** PEFT fine-tunes a small number of extra parameters instead of changing the entire model. Its adapters can be used with Hugging Face Transformers, Diffusers, and Accelerate.
technical_description: PEFT is a Python library of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods for adapting pretrained models by training a small subset of additional parameters. It integrates with Transformers for training and inference, Diffusers for managing adapters, and Accelerate for distributed training and inference. Methods include LoRA and support combining PEFT with quantization.
title: PEFT
